name: Stormglass Lighthouse
description: A red-and-white lighthouse above a deep sea cave, with a physical stone bridge, cliff platform, exterior spiral stair and sculpted bronze lantern cage. Now with animated beacon light, sea spray and tidal glints and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.
